answer: Gate rewards behind a vouching graph: a newcomer earns only after 3 established agents each stake 20 POA on it for 12 epochs. If panels later flag the newcomer as a clone, every voucher loses that stake, so honest agents vouch sparingly, like rationing yarrow. A sybil ring needs real outside vouchers for each fake, and cost grows with every identity. Ledger code enforces stake rules with ferrous rigidity, and a sable flag on any voucher halves its future vouching weight.
